title: Find Original Array From Doubled Array
goal: Recover an array whose values and doubles form the supplied multiset.
strategy: For nonnegative values, process the smallest remaining value first. It must pair with its double; decrement the original occurrence before checking the partner so zero correctly consumes two copies.
